title.en: Lost Medicaid in Kentucky? Next Steps for Coverage 2026
title.es: Perdio Medicaid en Kentucky? Pasos Siguientes 2026

description.en: Lost your Kentucky Medicaid (kynect) in 2026? You have 90 days to enroll in ACA Marketplace coverage through kynect. Compare plans, costs, and appeal rights.
description.es: Perdio Medicaid en Kentucky (kynect) en 2026? Tiene 90 dias para obtener cobertura del Mercado ACA. Compare planes y derechos de apelacion.

h1.en: Lost Your Medicaid in Kentucky? Here Are Your Next Steps for 2026
h1.es: Perdio su Medicaid en Kentucky? Estos Son Sus Proximos Pasos para 2026

subhero.en: Losing kynect Medicaid coverage triggers a 90-day Special Enrollment Period to enroll in a kynect Marketplace plan. You may also be able to appeal and get your Medicaid reinstated within 90 days.
subhero.es: Perder la cobertura de Medicaid de kynect activa un Periodo de Inscripcion Especial de 90 dias para inscribirse en un plan del Mercado de kynect. Tambien puede apelar y recuperar su Medicaid en 90 dias.

heading.en: You have 90 days from your Medicaid termination date
heading.es: Tiene 90 dias desde la fecha de terminacion de su Medicaid

body.en: Your 90-day Medicaid-loss Special Enrollment Period starts the day your kynect Medicaid coverage ends. For example, if your coverage ends June 30, 2026, your SEP window runs July 1 through September 28, 2026. Miss that window and you must wait until November 1, 2026 for the next ACA Open Enrollment Period. File your Medicaid appeal AND enroll in a kynect Marketplace plan at the same time to avoid any coverage gap.
body.es: Su Periodo de Inscripcion Especial de 90 dias comienza el dia en que termina su cobertura de Medicaid de kynect. Por ejemplo, si su cobertura termina el 30 de junio de 2026, su ventana SEP corre del 1 de julio al 28 de septiembre de 2026. Si pierde esa ventana, debe esperar hasta el 1 de noviembre de 2026 para el proximo Periodo de Inscripcion Abierta del ACA.

label.es: Ventana de apelacion de Medicaid (solicitar reintegracion)

quickAnswer.en: Losing Kentucky Medicaid (kynect) in 2026 triggers a 90-day Special Enrollment Period to enroll in a kynect Marketplace plan with premium subsidies. Your four options are: (1) appeal the Medicaid decision and get reinstated, (2) enroll in a kynect Marketplace plan (Silver plans average $662/mo before subsidies, often $10 to $200/mo after credits for income under 400% FPL), (3) apply for KCHIP if you have children under 19, or (4) enroll in COBRA if you recently had employer coverage. Most Kentuckians losing Medicaid at a 2026 redetermination qualify for significant Marketplace subsidies that make kynect plans affordable.
quickAnswer.es: Perder Medicaid de Kentucky (kynect) en 2026 activa un Periodo de Inscripcion Especial de 90 dias para inscribirse en un plan del Mercado de kynect con subsidios de prima. Sus cuatro opciones son: (1) apelar la decision de Medicaid y ser reintegrado, (2) inscribirse en un plan del Mercado de kynect (los planes Silver promedian $662/mes antes de subsidios, a menudo $10 a $200/mes despues de creditos para ingresos bajo el 400% FPL), (3) solicitar KCHIP si tiene hijos menores de 19 anos, o (4) inscribirse en COBRA si recientemente tuvo cobertura del empleador.

introParagraphs.en: Losing kynect Medicaid in Kentucky is one of the most disorienting healthcare moments a family can face. Kentucky expanded Medicaid under the ACA in 2014 and now covers roughly 1.5 million residents through its kynect portal. Annual redeterminations since the end of the COVID-19 public health emergency in 2023 have terminated coverage for hundreds of thousands of Kentuckians, many of whom lost coverage due to paperwork problems rather than actual income changes. If your kynect Medicaid ended in 2026, whether through a redetermination letter, a missed renewal, or an income change, federal rules give you a 90-day Special Enrollment Period to enroll in a new kynect Marketplace plan. During that 90-day window you can simultaneously file a Medicaid appeal, which may reinstate your coverage retroactively if you win.
introParagraphs.es: Perder Medicaid de kynect en Kentucky es uno de los momentos de salud mas desconcertantes que una familia puede enfrentar. Kentucky expandio Medicaid bajo la ACA en 2014 y ahora cubre a aproximadamente 1.5 millones de residentes a traves de su portal kynect. Las redeterminaciones anuales desde el final de la emergencia de salud publica de COVID-19 en 2023 han terminado la cobertura para cientos de miles de kentuckianos, muchos de los cuales perdieron cobertura debido a problemas de papeleo en lugar de cambios reales de ingresos. Si su Medicaid de kynect termino en 2026, ya sea a traves de una carta de redeterminacion, una renovacion no procesada, o un cambio de ingresos, las reglas federales le dan un Periodo de Inscripcion Especial de 90 dias para inscribirse en un nuevo plan del Mercado de kynect.

introParagraphs.en: Kentucky's kynect platform serves a dual role in 2026: it handles both Medicaid enrollment (administered by the Cabinet for Health and Family Services, CHFS) and ACA Marketplace plan enrollment for residents who do not qualify for Medicaid. This means that when Kentucky Medicaid ends, transitioning to a Marketplace plan happens on the same kynect portal at kynect.ky.gov, which simplifies the process compared to states that route Medicaid and Marketplace through separate systems. Three carriers offered kynect Marketplace plans in 2026: Anthem, WellCare, and Ambetter. Most lower-income Kentuckians who lose Medicaid will find that Medicaid income limits, ACA income limits, and premium tax credits make at least one kynect plan affordable. This guide covers the 7 steps to protect your coverage, how to appeal your Medicaid termination, and what documents you will need.
introParagraphs.es: La plataforma kynect de Kentucky cumple un doble rol en 2026: maneja tanto la inscripcion en Medicaid (administrada por el Gabinete de Servicios de Salud y Familia, CHFS) como la inscripcion en planes del Mercado ACA para residentes que no califican para Medicaid. Esto significa que cuando termina el Medicaid de Kentucky, la transicion a un plan del Mercado ocurre en el mismo portal kynect en kynect.ky.gov, lo que simplifica el proceso. Tres aseguradoras ofrecieron planes del Mercado de kynect en 2026: Anthem, WellCare y Ambetter. La mayoria de los kentuckianos de bajos ingresos que pierden Medicaid encontraran que los limites de ingresos de Medicaid, los limites de ingresos ACA y los creditos fiscales de prima hacen que al menos un plan de kynect sea asequible.

name.en: Read your termination notice carefully and note the end date
name.es: Lea su aviso de terminacion con cuidado y anote la fecha de vencimiento

text.en: Your Medicaid termination notice from CHFS or DCBS states the exact date your kynect Medicaid coverage ends. That date starts your 90-day Special Enrollment Period clock. Keep the notice, as you will need it to prove the qualifying life event when enrolling in a kynect Marketplace plan or appealing the decision.
text.es: Su aviso de terminacion de Medicaid de CHFS o DCBS indica la fecha exacta en que termina su cobertura de Medicaid de kynect. Esa fecha inicia su reloj de Periodo de Inscripcion Especial de 90 dias. Guarde el aviso, ya que lo necesitara para demostrar el evento de vida calificador al inscribirse en un plan del Mercado de kynect o apelar la decision.

name.en: File your Medicaid appeal within 90 days (within 10 days to keep benefits during the appeal)
name.es: Presente su apelacion de Medicaid en 90 dias (dentro de 10 dias para conservar beneficios durante la apelacion)

text.en: Submit a Medicaid appeal through your kynect account online at kynect.ky.gov, by calling DCBS at 855-306-8959, or by mailing a written request to the address on your termination notice. If you appeal within 10 days of the notice, your Medicaid benefits continue while the appeal is pending. If the appeal succeeds, coverage is reinstated retroactively with no gap. Even if you enroll in a Marketplace plan as a backup, winning the appeal lets you cancel the Marketplace plan without penalty.
text.es: Envie una apelacion de Medicaid a traves de su cuenta de kynect en linea en kynect.ky.gov, llamando a DCBS al 855-306-8959, o enviando una solicitud por escrito a la direccion en su aviso de terminacion. Si apela dentro de los 10 dias del aviso, sus beneficios de Medicaid continuan mientras la apelacion esta pendiente. Si la apelacion tiene exito, la cobertura se reinstala retroactivamente sin brecha.

name.es: Calcule su ingreso del hogar proyectado para 2026

text.en: Log in to kynect.ky.gov and use the income screener to check whether your income now puts you at 138% FPL or above for 2026 (about $22,025 for a single person, $45,540 for a family of 4). Incomes between 138% and 400% FPL qualify for premium tax credits on kynect Marketplace plans. Incomes at or below 138% FPL in Kentucky still qualify for Medicaid, meaning the termination may have been an error worth appealing. Use only your projected 2026 income going forward, not past-year figures.
text.es: Inicie sesion en kynect.ky.gov y use el verificador de ingresos para comprobar si su ingreso ahora lo coloca en el 138% FPL o mas para 2026 (aproximadamente $22,025 para una sola persona, $45,540 para una familia de 4). Los ingresos entre el 138% y el 400% del FPL califican para creditos fiscales de prima en los planes del Mercado de kynect. Los ingresos en o por debajo del 138% del FPL en Kentucky todavia califican para Medicaid, lo que significa que la terminacion puede haber sido un error que vale la pena apelar.

name.en: Check if your children qualify for KCHIP
name.es: Verifique si sus hijos califican para KCHIP

text.en: KCHIP (Kentucky Children's Health Insurance Program) covers children under 19 whose family income is too high for Medicaid but does not exceed 218% FPL for 2026. KCHIP enrollment is year-round with no deadline, and monthly premiums are very low (typically $15 to $45 per child per month). Apply through kynect.ky.gov or by calling 855-459-6328. KCHIP enrollment is separate from your own adult Marketplace enrollment.
text.es: KCHIP (Programa de Seguro de Salud Infantil de Kentucky) cubre a ninos menores de 19 anos cuyo ingreso familiar es demasiado alto para Medicaid pero no supera el 218% del FPL para 2026. La inscripcion en KCHIP es durante todo el ano sin fecha limite, y las primas mensuales son muy bajas (tipicamente $15 a $45 por nino por mes). Solicite a traves de kynect.ky.gov o llamando al 855-459-6328.

name.en: Compare kynect Marketplace plans and select a plan before your 90-day SEP expires
name.es: Compare los planes del Mercado de kynect y seleccione un plan antes de que expire su SEP de 90 dias

text.en: Log in to kynect.ky.gov, enter your qualifying life event (loss of Medicaid), and compare Silver, Bronze, and Gold plans from Anthem, WellCare, and Ambetter. For 2026, Silver plans average $662/mo before subsidies but drop significantly with premium tax credits. Most Kentuckians losing Medicaid at 138% to 250% FPL qualify for cost-sharing reductions on Silver plans, meaning lower deductibles and copays. Apply online at kynect.ky.gov or call 1-855-4kynect (855-459-6328).
text.es: Inicie sesion en kynect.ky.gov, ingrese su evento de vida calificador (perdida de Medicaid) y compare los planes Silver, Bronze y Gold de Anthem, WellCare y Ambetter. Para 2026, los planes Silver promedian $662/mes antes de subsidios pero bajan significativamente con los creditos fiscales de prima. La mayoria de los kentuckianos que pierden Medicaid entre el 138% y el 250% del FPL califican para reducciones de costos compartidos en planes Silver. Solicite en linea en kynect.ky.gov o llame al 1-855-4kynect (855-459-6328).

name.en: Gather and submit your documentation to confirm the SEP qualifying event
name.es: Reuna y envie su documentacion para confirmar el evento calificador del SEP

text.en: Upload your Medicaid termination letter from CHFS to your kynect account as proof of the qualifying life event. kynect accepts electronic uploads directly through the portal. If kynect requests additional documentation, submit within the stated deadline (usually 30 days) to avoid enrollment cancellation. Keep copies of all submitted documents.
text.es: Suba su carta de terminacion de Medicaid de CHFS a su cuenta de kynect como prueba del evento de vida calificador. kynect acepta cargas electronicas directamente a traves del portal. Si kynect solicita documentacion adicional, enviela dentro del plazo indicado (generalmente 30 dias) para evitar la cancelacion de la inscripcion.

name.en: Pay your first premium to activate your new coverage
name.es: Pague su primera prima para activar su nueva cobertura

text.en: After selecting a kynect Marketplace plan, your coverage is NOT active until you pay your first month's premium. Log in to the carrier's billing portal (Anthem, WellCare, or Ambetter) and pay immediately. Coverage typically starts the first of the month after enrollment. If you need coverage to start sooner, enroll by the 15th of the month for coverage starting the 1st of the following month. Keep your payment confirmation as proof of active coverage.
text.es: Despues de seleccionar un plan del Mercado de kynect, su cobertura NO esta activa hasta que pague su primera prima mensual. Inicie sesion en el portal de facturacion del asegurador (Anthem, WellCare o Ambetter) y pague de inmediato. La cobertura generalmente comienza el primero del mes despues de la inscripcion. Guarde su confirmacion de pago como prueba de cobertura activa.

intro.en: The most costly mistakes Kentuckians make after losing Medicaid coverage in 2026:
intro.es: Los errores mas costosos que cometen los kentuckianos despues de perder la cobertura de Medicaid en 2026:

items.en: Missing both the 90-day SEP AND the Medicaid appeal window. Both clocks start on the same day your Medicaid ends. Many Kentuckians assume they must choose one or the other; you can and should file the appeal and enroll in a Marketplace plan simultaneously.
items.es: Perder tanto el SEP de 90 dias como la ventana de apelacion de Medicaid. Ambos relojes comienzan el mismo dia que termina su Medicaid. Muchos kentuckianos asumen que deben elegir uno u otro; puede y debe presentar la apelacion e inscribirse en un plan del Mercado al mismo tiempo.

items.en: Not appealing within 10 days. If you appeal within 10 days of your termination notice, your Medicaid benefits continue during the appeal. Wait longer and there is a coverage gap even if you win.
items.es: No apelar dentro de los 10 dias. Si apela dentro de los 10 dias de su aviso de terminacion, sus beneficios de Medicaid continuan durante la apelacion. Esperar mas tiempo significa una brecha de cobertura incluso si gana.

items.en: Using last year's income instead of projected 2026 income. kynect Marketplace subsidies are calculated on your projected Modified Adjusted Gross Income (MAGI) for 2026, not what you earned in 2025. If your income dropped after a Medicaid termination, your subsidy may be larger than you expect.
items.es: Usar el ingreso del ano pasado en lugar del ingreso proyectado para 2026. Los subsidios del Mercado de kynect se calculan sobre su Ingreso Bruto Ajustado Modificado (MAGI) proyectado para 2026, no lo que gano en 2025.

items.en: Forgetting to pay the first premium. Selecting a kynect Marketplace plan does not activate coverage. You must pay the first month's premium directly to Anthem, WellCare, or Ambetter. Skipping this step leaves you uninsured despite completing enrollment.
items.es: Olvidar pagar la primera prima. Seleccionar un plan del Mercado de kynect no activa la cobertura. Debe pagar la primera prima del mes directamente a Anthem, WellCare o Ambetter. Omitir este paso lo deja sin seguro a pesar de haber completado la inscripcion.

items.en: Skipping kynect and going to a short-term health plan broker. Short-term plans are not ACA-compliant, do not cover pre-existing conditions, and may not count as minimum essential coverage. Use kynect.ky.gov for legitimate ACA Marketplace plans.
items.es: Saltarse kynect y acudir a un corredor de planes de salud a corto plazo. Los planes a corto plazo no cumplen con la ACA, no cubren condiciones preexistentes y pueden no contar como cobertura minima esencial. Use kynect.ky.gov para planes legitimos del Mercado ACA.

heading.en: kynect Marketplace vs Medicaid Reinstatement vs COBRA: Which Path Should You Take?
heading.es: Mercado kynect vs Reintegracion de Medicaid vs COBRA: Cual Camino Debe Tomar?

body.en: Losing Kentucky Medicaid in 2026 opens three distinct paths, and the right choice depends on your current income and whether your Medicaid was terminated in error. Medicaid reinstatement via appeal is always the first move for anyone whose 2026 income is still at or below 138% FPL ($22,025 for a single adult), because Medicaid is free, covers comprehensively, and can be retroactively reinstated. File the appeal while simultaneously enrolling in a kynect Marketplace plan as a safety net. kynect Marketplace plans are the most common 2026 path for those whose income moved above 138% FPL: Silver plans with cost-sharing reductions are typically the best value for incomes between 138% and 250% FPL (about $22,025 to $39,900 for a single adult), with lower deductibles and out-of-pocket costs than Bronze. COBRA is the last-resort option for Kentuckians who recently left employer coverage and need to maintain access to a specific specialist not in any kynect Marketplace network; COBRA costs 102% of the full premium (often $700 to $2,000 per month for a family) and is rarely cheaper than a subsidized kynect plan. One Kentucky-specific note: kynect.ky.gov handles both the Medicaid appeal and Marketplace enrollment in the same account, which streamlines the dual-track approach more than in most states.
body.es: Perder Medicaid de Kentucky en 2026 abre tres caminos distintos, y la eleccion correcta depende de su ingreso actual y si su Medicaid fue terminado por error. La reintegracion de Medicaid mediante apelacion es siempre el primer paso para cualquier persona cuyo ingreso de 2026 todavia este en o por debajo del 138% FPL ($22,025 para un adulto soltero), porque Medicaid es gratuito, cubre de manera integral y puede ser reinstalado retroactivamente. Presente la apelacion mientras simultaneamente se inscribe en un plan del Mercado de kynect como red de seguridad. Los planes del Mercado de kynect son la via mas comun en 2026 para quienes cuyos ingresos superaron el 138% FPL: los planes Silver con reducciones de costos compartidos son tipicamente la mejor opcion para ingresos entre el 138% y el 250% FPL. COBRA es la opcion de ultimo recurso para los kentuckianos que recientemente dejaron la cobertura del empleador y necesitan mantener acceso a un especialista especifico que no esta en ninguna red del Mercado de kynect.

stateRules.rule: Kentucky operates kynect (kynect.ky.gov) as a state-based marketplace and integrated Medicaid portal. Marketplace plans are NOT enrolled through healthcare.gov; all Kentucky ACA Marketplace enrollment goes through kynect.ky.gov or by calling 1-855-4kynect. kynect also handles Medicaid applications, renewals, appeals, and KCHIP enrollment in the same account.

Medicaid termination appeals must be filed within 90 days of the notice date. Filing within 10 days of the notice preserves Medicaid benefits during the appeal (Kentucky State Fair Hearing process, DCBS). Contact DCBS at 855-306-8959 or 855-459-6328 (Medicaid-only line).

KCHIP (Kentucky Children's Health Insurance Program) covers children under 19 with family income up to 218% FPL. KCHIP is year-round enrollment with no deadline and is administered through kynect. Premiums range from $0 to $45/mo per child depending on income.

Kentucky expanded Medicaid under the ACA in 2014. As of 2026, all Kentucky adults ages 19-64 with household income at or below 138% FPL ($22,025 individual; $45,540 family of 4) qualify for Kentucky Medicaid. Pregnant women qualify at up to 200% FPL. There is no asset test for ACA-expansion Medicaid adults.

heading.en: Understanding Kentucky Medicaid Terminations in 2026: Why Coverage Ends and What Triggers the SEP
heading.es: Entendiendo las Terminaciones de Medicaid de Kentucky en 2026: Por Que Termina la Cobertura y Que Activa el SEP

paragraphs.en: Kentucky Medicaid terminations in 2026 fall into three main categories, each with different implications for your next steps. First, annual redeterminations by CHFS can end coverage when DCBS finds your household income now exceeds 138% FPL based on data from the IRS, Social Security Administration, or other state agencies, or when renewal paperwork is not returned within the required window. Second, procedural terminations happen when kynect cannot reach a member by mail or phone during the renewal process, even when that member still qualifies for Medicaid. Procedural terminations are the most common and most likely to succeed on appeal. Third, voluntary terminations or transitions occur when a member gains employer-based coverage or moves out of Kentucky.
paragraphs.es: Las terminaciones de Medicaid de Kentucky en 2026 caen en tres categorias principales, cada una con diferentes implicaciones para sus proximos pasos. Primero, las redeterminaciones anuales de CHFS pueden terminar la cobertura cuando DCBS encuentra que el ingreso de su hogar ahora supera el 138% FPL basado en datos del IRS, la Administracion del Seguro Social u otras agencias estatales, o cuando los documentos de renovacion no se devuelven dentro del plazo requerido. Segundo, las terminaciones por procedimiento ocurren cuando kynect no puede comunicarse con un miembro por correo o telefono durante el proceso de renovacion, incluso cuando ese miembro todavia califica para Medicaid.

paragraphs.en: Federal rules require that losing Medicaid or CHIP triggers a 90-day Special Enrollment Period for ACA Marketplace plans. This is longer than the standard 60-day SEP for most other qualifying life events, and it is intentional: Congress built in extra time to allow states and enrollees to resolve redetermination disputes before locking people into Marketplace plans. The 90-day SEP also applies whether your Medicaid ended by termination letter or by expiration of coverage during an appeal you eventually lost. Keep the CHFS termination notice as your primary qualifying event document for kynect Marketplace enrollment.
paragraphs.es: Las reglas federales requieren que perder Medicaid o CHIP active un Periodo de Inscripcion Especial de 90 dias para los planes del Mercado ACA. Esto es mas largo que el SEP estandar de 60 dias para la mayoria de los otros eventos de vida calificadores, y es intencional: el Congreso incorporo tiempo extra para permitir que los estados y los inscritos resuelvan las disputas de redeterminacion antes de vincular a las personas a planes del Mercado.

heading.en: Medicaid Income Limits and ACA Subsidy Thresholds in Kentucky 2026
heading.es: Limites de Ingresos de Medicaid y Umbrales de Subsidio ACA en Kentucky 2026

paragraphs.en: Kentucky's Medicaid income limits and ACA subsidy thresholds create an eligibility ladder for 2026. Adults ages 19-64 qualify for free Kentucky Medicaid at or below 138% of the Federal Poverty Level: roughly $22,025 for a single adult or $45,540 for a family of 4, based on the 2026 HHS ASPE poverty guidelines. Between 138% and 400% FPL, adults qualify for premium tax credits on kynect Marketplace plans, with the credit size decreasing as income rises. For 2026, the ACA subsidy cliff returned to 400% FPL ($63,840 for a single adult) after the enhanced premium tax credits from the American Rescue Plan Act and the Inflation Reduction Act expired on January 1, 2026. Adults with income above 400% FPL in Kentucky pay full kynect Marketplace premiums without federal subsidy assistance.
paragraphs.es: Los limites de ingresos de Medicaid de Kentucky y los umbrales de subsidio ACA crean una escala de elegibilidad para 2026. Los adultos de 19 a 64 anos califican para Medicaid de Kentucky gratuito en o por debajo del 138% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza: aproximadamente $22,025 para un adulto soltero o $45,540 para una familia de 4, basado en las pautas de pobreza de HHS ASPE 2026. Entre el 138% y el 400% del FPL, los adultos califican para creditos fiscales de prima en los planes del Mercado de kynect, con el tamano del credito disminuyendo a medida que aumentan los ingresos.

paragraphs.en: Medicaid income limits and cost-sharing reductions on kynect Silver plans make the transition from Medicaid to Marketplace most affordable for incomes between 138% and 250% FPL. At this income range, Silver plans with cost-sharing reductions (CSRs) have lower deductibles (often $500 to $1,500 vs the standard $4,500 to $7,500), lower copays, and lower out-of-pocket maximums. CSRs are only available on Silver plans purchased through kynect.ky.gov. Checking Medicaid income limits before assuming you no longer qualify is essential: if a data error caused your termination, a successful appeal returns you to free coverage. CHIP-eligible children remain covered through KCHIP at up to 218% FPL regardless of whether the parent transitions to a kynect Marketplace plan.
paragraphs.es: Los limites de ingresos de Medicaid y las reducciones de costos compartidos en los planes Silver de kynect hacen que la transicion de Medicaid al Mercado sea mas asequible para ingresos entre el 138% y el 250% del FPL. En este rango de ingresos, los planes Silver con reducciones de costos compartidos (CSR) tienen deducibles mas bajos (a menudo $500 a $1,500 frente a los $4,500 a $7,500 estandar), copagos mas bajos y maximos de gastos de bolsillo mas bajos.

heading.en: The kynect Marketplace in 2026: Plans, Carriers, and What to Expect After Medicaid
heading.es: El Mercado kynect en 2026: Planes, Aseguradoras y Que Esperar Despues de Medicaid

paragraphs.en: kynect is Kentucky's state-based marketplace and is separate from healthcare.gov. Kentucky residents do NOT use healthcare.gov to enroll in Marketplace plans; all kynect Marketplace enrollment happens at kynect.ky.gov or by calling 1-855-4kynect (855-459-6328). For 2026, three carriers offered plans through kynect: Anthem (with two networks, Pathway and Transition), WellCare, and Ambetter. Silver plans averaged about $662 per month before subsidies for a 40-year-old, and Bronze plans averaged about $520 per month. After premium tax credits, most Kentuckians losing Medicaid at 138% to 300% FPL pay $10 to $200 per month for a Silver plan with significant cost-sharing reductions that reduce out-of-pocket costs.
paragraphs.es: kynect es el mercado estatal de Kentucky y es separado de healthcare.gov. Los residentes de Kentucky NO usan healthcare.gov para inscribirse en planes del Mercado; toda la inscripcion del Mercado de kynect ocurre en kynect.ky.gov o llamando al 1-855-4kynect (855-459-6328). Para 2026, tres aseguradoras ofrecieron planes a traves de kynect: Anthem (con dos redes, Pathway y Transition), WellCare y Ambetter. Los planes Silver promediaron alrededor de $662 por mes antes de subsidios para una persona de 40 anos, y los planes Bronze promediaron alrededor de $520 por mes.

paragraphs.en: When transitioning from kynect Medicaid to a kynect Marketplace plan, your existing kynect account carries over. Log into your account at kynect.ky.gov, report the loss of Medicaid as your qualifying life event, and the system will walk you through plan comparison. kynect will prompt you to report your projected 2026 Modified Adjusted Gross Income (MAGI) for subsidy calculation. Enter your best estimate of what you expect to earn in 2026, including wages, self-employment income, and unemployment benefits if applicable. Selecting a Silver plan with cost-sharing reductions gives you the most comprehensive benefits at the lowest out-of-pocket costs if your income is under 250% FPL. Your 1095-A tax form from kynect will arrive in January 2027 for reconciling the premium tax credit on your 2026 federal tax return.
paragraphs.es: Al hacer la transicion de Medicaid de kynect a un plan del Mercado de kynect, su cuenta existente de kynect se transfiere. Inicie sesion en su cuenta en kynect.ky.gov, reporte la perdida de Medicaid como su evento de vida calificador, y el sistema lo guiara a traves de la comparacion de planes. Seleccionar un plan Silver con reducciones de costos compartidos le brinda los beneficios mas completos a los menores costos de bolsillo si su ingreso esta por debajo del 250% FPL. Su formulario de impuestos 1095-A de kynect llegara en enero de 2027 para reconciliar el credito fiscal de prima en su declaracion de impuestos federales de 2026.

en.question: How long do I have to enroll in a kynect Marketplace plan after losing Kentucky Medicaid?
en.answer: You have 90 days from the date your Kentucky Medicaid coverage ends to enroll in a kynect Marketplace plan under the Medicaid-loss Special Enrollment Period. This 90-day window is longer than the standard 60-day SEP for most qualifying life events. For example, if your Medicaid ends June 30, 2026, your SEP window runs through September 28, 2026. After the 90 days expire, you must wait until the next ACA Open Enrollment Period starting November 1, 2026, for 2027 coverage. Medicaid itself is year-round if your income later drops back to or below 138% FPL.

en.question: Can I appeal my Kentucky Medicaid termination and still enroll in a kynect Marketplace plan?
en.answer: Yes, and you should do both simultaneously. Filing a Medicaid appeal through kynect.ky.gov or by calling DCBS at 855-306-8959 does not prevent you from enrolling in a kynect Marketplace plan during your 90-day SEP. If you appeal within 10 days of your termination notice, your Medicaid benefits continue during the appeal. If you win the appeal, your Medicaid is reinstated retroactively and you can cancel the Marketplace plan without a penalty. If the appeal fails, your kynect Marketplace coverage serves as your backup. Filing both protects you regardless of the appeal outcome.

en.question: Do I qualify for a Marketplace subsidy after losing Kentucky Medicaid?
en.answer: Most Kentuckians losing Medicaid in 2026 qualify for premium tax credits on kynect Marketplace plans if their income is between 138% and 400% FPL. For 2026, 138% FPL is about $22,025 for a single adult or $45,540 for a family of 4, and 400% FPL is about $63,840 for a single adult or $132,000 for a family of 4. The ACA subsidy cliff returned to 400% FPL for 2026 after enhanced premium tax credits from ARPA and the Inflation Reduction Act expired January 1, 2026. Incomes at or below 138% FPL typically still qualify for Kentucky Medicaid, making the termination potentially an error worth appealing. Use kynect.ky.gov to check current subsidy eligibility based on your projected 2026 income.

en.question: Does losing Medicaid in Kentucky affect my children's KCHIP coverage?
en.answer: KCHIP (Kentucky Children's Health Insurance Program) is separate from adult Medicaid and has its own income threshold of up to 218% FPL for children under 19. KCHIP enrollment is year-round with no deadline, so even if you lose your own Medicaid coverage, your children may remain eligible for KCHIP or qualify to enroll. KCHIP premiums range from $0 to about $45 per child per month depending on income. Apply or check KCHIP eligibility through kynect.ky.gov or by calling 855-459-6328. Your children's KCHIP coverage is not automatically terminated when your adult Medicaid ends.

en.question: What documents do I need to prove my Kentucky Medicaid loss for the kynect SEP?
en.answer: The primary document you need is your official Medicaid termination or redetermination notice from CHFS or DCBS. kynect accepts electronic uploads of this notice directly through your kynect account. Additional documents that may be requested include Social Security numbers for all household members, proof of Kentucky residence, and documentation of your projected 2026 household income such as recent pay stubs, an unemployment award letter, or a self-employment income estimate. Upload documents promptly; kynect typically gives you 30 days from enrollment to submit supporting documentation before canceling your enrollment.

en.question: Is COBRA a good option after losing Kentucky Medicaid?
en.answer: COBRA is rarely the right choice after losing Medicaid in Kentucky. COBRA applies only if you also recently had employer-based group health coverage and that coverage ended as a qualifying event. COBRA costs 102% of the full premium, which is often $700 to $2,000 per month for a family plan, compared to $10 to $200 per month for a subsidized kynect Silver Marketplace plan. The only scenario where COBRA makes sense is if you have ongoing treatment with a specialist who is not in any kynect Marketplace network, or if you have already met a large deductible for 2026 that you want to protect. Otherwise, a kynect Marketplace plan with subsidies is almost always the better value after Medicaid loss.

en.question: What are the income limits for Kentucky Medicaid in 2026?
en.answer: Kentucky expanded Medicaid under the ACA in 2014. Adults ages 19-64 qualify for Kentucky Medicaid (administered through kynect) at or below 138% of the Federal Poverty Level: about $22,025 per year for a single adult, $29,820 for a 2-person household, $37,615 for a 3-person household, and $45,540 for a family of 4 in 2026. Pregnant women qualify at up to 200% FPL. Children may qualify for KCHIP at up to 218% FPL. There is no asset test for ACA-expansion Medicaid adults. Medicaid income limits are based on Modified Adjusted Gross Income (MAGI), which includes wages, self-employment income, unemployment benefits, and Social Security income.

en.question: What happens if I miss the 90-day SEP after losing Kentucky Medicaid?
en.answer: Missing the 90-day Medicaid-loss Special Enrollment Period means you cannot enroll in a kynect Marketplace plan until the next ACA Open Enrollment Period, which begins November 1, 2026, for 2027 coverage. During the gap between your Medicaid termination and the next Open Enrollment, you would be uninsured unless another qualifying life event (marriage, birth, job loss with employer coverage) opens a new SEP. If your income remains at or below 138% FPL, you can apply for Medicaid at any time year-round through kynect.ky.gov, since Medicaid has no SEP deadline. The best defense against missing the 90-day window is to file both the Medicaid appeal and the Marketplace enrollment application on the same day you receive your termination notice.

es.question: Cuanto tiempo tengo para inscribirme en un plan del Mercado de kynect despues de perder Medicaid de Kentucky?
es.answer: Tiene 90 dias desde la fecha en que termina su cobertura de Medicaid de Kentucky para inscribirse en un plan del Mercado de kynect bajo el Periodo de Inscripcion Especial por perdida de Medicaid. Esta ventana de 90 dias es mas larga que el SEP estandar de 60 dias para la mayoria de los eventos de vida calificadores. Por ejemplo, si su Medicaid termina el 30 de junio de 2026, su ventana SEP corre hasta el 28 de septiembre de 2026. Despues de que expiren los 90 dias, debe esperar hasta el proximo Periodo de Inscripcion Abierta del ACA que comienza el 1 de noviembre de 2026 para cobertura de 2027. Medicaid en si es durante todo el ano si su ingreso cae posteriormente al 138% FPL o por debajo.

es.question: Puedo apelar la terminacion de mi Medicaid de Kentucky y aun inscribirme en un plan del Mercado de kynect?
es.answer: Si, y deberia hacer ambas cosas simultaneamente. Presentar una apelacion de Medicaid a traves de kynect.ky.gov o llamando a DCBS al 855-306-8959 no le impide inscribirse en un plan del Mercado de kynect durante su SEP de 90 dias. Si apela dentro de los 10 dias de su aviso de terminacion, sus beneficios de Medicaid continuan durante la apelacion. Si gana la apelacion, su Medicaid se reinstala retroactivamente y puede cancelar el plan del Mercado sin penalizacion. Si la apelacion falla, su cobertura del Mercado de kynect sirve como respaldo.

es.question: Califico para un subsidio del Mercado despues de perder Medicaid de Kentucky?
es.answer: La mayoria de los kentuckianos que pierden Medicaid en 2026 califican para creditos fiscales de prima en los planes del Mercado de kynect si sus ingresos estan entre el 138% y el 400% del FPL. Para 2026, el 138% del FPL es aproximadamente $22,025 para un adulto soltero o $45,540 para una familia de 4, y el 400% del FPL es aproximadamente $63,840 para un adulto soltero o $132,000 para una familia de 4. El techo de subsidio ACA regreso al 400% del FPL para 2026 despues de que los creditos fiscales de prima mejorados del ARPA y la Ley de Reduccion de la Inflacion expiraron el 1 de enero de 2026. Use kynect.ky.gov para verificar la elegibilidad actual de subsidio basada en su ingreso proyectado de 2026.

es.question: La perdida de Medicaid en Kentucky afecta la cobertura KCHIP de mis hijos?
es.answer: KCHIP (Programa de Seguro de Salud Infantil de Kentucky) es separado del Medicaid de adultos y tiene su propio umbral de ingresos de hasta el 218% del FPL para ninos menores de 19 anos. La inscripcion en KCHIP es durante todo el ano sin fecha limite, por lo que incluso si pierde su propia cobertura de Medicaid, sus hijos pueden permanecer elegibles para KCHIP o calificar para inscribirse. Las primas de KCHIP van desde $0 hasta aproximadamente $45 por nino por mes dependiendo del ingreso. Solicite o verifique la elegibilidad de KCHIP a traves de kynect.ky.gov o llamando al 855-459-6328.

es.question: Que documentos necesito para demostrar mi perdida de Medicaid de Kentucky para el SEP de kynect?
es.answer: El documento principal que necesita es su aviso oficial de terminacion o redeterminacion de Medicaid de CHFS o DCBS. kynect acepta cargas electronicas de este aviso directamente a traves de su cuenta de kynect. Los documentos adicionales que pueden solicitarse incluyen numeros de Seguro Social para todos los miembros del hogar, prueba de residencia en Kentucky y documentacion de su ingreso familiar proyectado de 2026, como talones de pago recientes, una carta de beneficios de desempleo o una estimacion de ingresos por cuenta propia. Suba los documentos rapidamente; kynect generalmente le da 30 dias desde la inscripcion para enviar la documentacion de apoyo antes de cancelar su inscripcion.

es.question: Es COBRA una buena opcion despues de perder Medicaid de Kentucky?
es.answer: COBRA rara vez es la eleccion correcta despues de perder Medicaid en Kentucky. COBRA solo aplica si recientemente tambien tuvo cobertura de salud grupal basada en el empleador y esa cobertura termino como un evento calificador. COBRA cuesta el 102% de la prima completa, que es a menudo $700 a $2,000 por mes para un plan familiar, comparado con $10 a $200 por mes para un plan Silver del Mercado de kynect con subsidios. El unico escenario donde COBRA tiene sentido es si tiene tratamiento continuo con un especialista que no esta en ninguna red del Mercado de kynect.

es.question: Cuales son los limites de ingresos para Medicaid de Kentucky en 2026?
es.answer: Kentucky expandio Medicaid bajo la ACA en 2014. Los adultos de 19 a 64 anos califican para Medicaid de Kentucky (administrado a traves de kynect) en o por debajo del 138% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza: aproximadamente $22,025 por ano para un adulto soltero, $29,820 para un hogar de 2 personas, $37,615 para un hogar de 3 personas y $45,540 para una familia de 4 en 2026. Las mujeres embarazadas califican hasta el 200% del FPL. Los ninos pueden calificar para KCHIP hasta el 218% del FPL. No hay prueba de activos para los adultos de Medicaid en expansion ACA. Los limites de ingresos de Medicaid se basan en el Ingreso Bruto Ajustado Modificado (MAGI).

es.question: Que pasa si pierdo el SEP de 90 dias despues de perder Medicaid de Kentucky?
es.answer: Perder el Periodo de Inscripcion Especial de 90 dias por perdida de Medicaid significa que no puede inscribirse en un plan del Mercado de kynect hasta el proximo Periodo de Inscripcion Abierta del ACA, que comienza el 1 de noviembre de 2026 para cobertura de 2027. Si su ingreso sigue estando en o por debajo del 138% del FPL, puede solicitar Medicaid en cualquier momento durante todo el ano a traves de kynect.ky.gov, ya que Medicaid no tiene fecha limite de SEP. La mejor defensa contra perder la ventana de 90 dias es presentar tanto la apelacion de Medicaid como la solicitud de inscripcion del Mercado el mismo dia que recibe su aviso de terminacion.
